g.text: An ion activity product is compared with the equilibrium solubility product

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Illustrative25°C-like Ksp input, ideal dilute solution with equal free ion concentrations and1 mol/L standard state. Activities are dimensionless;
concentrations are used numerically only under that convention. Common ions, complexation and activity corrections omitted. Supersaturation permits
precipitation thermodynamically but does not establish nucleation rate.
